short_description: How much of the year, the month, your own span or your life has passed, as progress bars.
description:
## What you see

Two lines with progress bars: the year on top, such as 2026 87%, and under it the line you pick with the wheel.

## Lines

- **Month**, counted from any day: set 12 and you see how far you are from one payday to the next.
- **Week** and **day**.
- **Your own span** between two dates, with your label, such as BABY 75%.
- **Life**: the share lived, from your birth date and the years you set.
- Two pixel views, one pixel per unit: the days of the year, and the months of your life.

The year can start on any date too, such as your birthday. A spark runs along the year's bar at each new whole percent.

## Settings

The year's start and label, the month's start day and label, your span's label and dates (YYYY-MM-DD), your birth date and the years of life. All of them are optional.

Works offline, on the BUSY Bar's own clock.
changelog: First release: year, month, week, day, your own span, life, and two pixel views.
